test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The detention of a person cannot exceed ______ unless an advisory board consisting of judges of a High Court reports sufficient cause for extended detention.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three months**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Protection against arrest and detention in certain cases.**

 
 
• **​**No person who is arrested shall be detained in custody without being informed.
 
• Every person who is arrested and detained in custody shall be produced before the nearest magistrate within a period of twenty-four hours.
 
• No law providing for preventive detention shall authorize the detention of a person for a longer period than three months.
 
 
 
• The statement is mentioned in **Article 22(4)** of the Indian Constitution.
